corpse-perish: Will perish in {0} days in current conditions ({1}% rotted)
corpse-locked: This corpse is locked and cannot be interacted with for another {0} hours
corpse-hang: Drag onto a skinning hook to hang the body up
corpse-hangable: Can be put on a Butchering hook
corpse-takedown: Hold to take the body down (while empty-handed)
corpse-unstow: Hold to unload the body (while empty-handed)
corpse-stowblocked: There is no room to stow a body
corpse-stowoccupied: Something is already stowed on this animal's back
corpse-hookoccupied: Something already hangs on this hook
corpse-notempty: The body must be stripped of all worn clothes and armor first
corpse-tablehint: Drag on top of a butchering table to get more harvesting drops
corpse-bledout: This body has been skinned and bled out
loot-interrupted: You were interrupted while searching the body
carving-title: Something has been carved into it:
wound-gravity: Broken bones from a hard fall
LootHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds to hold Shift + Right Mouse to open a corpse's inventory.
LootAllHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds to hold Ctrl + Right Mouse to loot everything from a corpse at once.
BodyExpireDays-comment: In-game days before a corpse rots away. Its contents drop on the ground and skeletal remains are left behind. Set to 0 to disable.
ClothingDecayFactor-comment: How much condition the clothing worn by a corpse loses over a full rot, and 1 durability per percent rotted on top. 0.75 = a pristine garment is down to 25% condition by the time the body rots away. Armor is never affected. Set to 0 to disable.
CorpseLockHours-comment: In-game hours during which only the corpse's owner can loot or drag it. Set to 0 to disable.
CorpseWoundCount-comment: Number of most recent wounds shown when inspecting a corpse. Set to 0 to disable.
CorpseWoundLogEnabled-comment: Whether a player's damage log is copied onto their corpse on death.
CorpseWoundShowWeapon-comment: Whether the weapon that caused a wound is shown in the corpse wound log.
WoundDetailTraits-comment: Comma-separated trait codes (e.g. pilferer, mender) that see the body part, weapon and damage of each wound. Everyone else only sees the wound types, and poisoning and starvation are hidden from them. Leave empty to show full details to everyone.
ShowCorpseRace-comment: Whether the race of the body is shown when looking at a corpse.
CorpseFloatAfterHours-comment: In-game hours after death until a corpse in water bloats up and floats to the surface. Set to 0 to float right away, -1 to always sink.
DragHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds to hold Right Mouse on a body to start dragging it.
DragRange-comment: Maximum distance (in blocks) to start dragging a body.
DragWalkSpeedMultiplier-comment: Walk speed change while dragging a body. -1 = cannot move, 0 = normal speed.
StowHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds to keep aiming at the animal's back slot while dragging a body until it gets stowed.
DisableHarvesting-comment: Completely disable harvesting bodies: no hanging, skinning, quartering or harvesting, and no drops.
KeepInventoryOnDeath-comment: What a player keeps through death. None: everything goes onto the corpse. ArmorAndClothing: worn armor and clothes stay on the player, the rest goes onto the corpse. All: the whole inventory stays on the player and the corpse spawns empty.
HarvestingLootMultiplier-comment: Multiplies everything harvesting a body yields: meat, offal, sinew, bones, fat, hides, blood and the skull. Set to 0 to disable drops entirely.
HangHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds to keep aiming at a skinning hook while dragging a body until it gets hung up.
SkinHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds to hold Right Mouse with a knife to skin a hanging body.
QuarterHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds to hold Right Mouse with a knife or cleaver to quarter a skinned body on the ground.
HarvestHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds to hold Right Mouse with a knife or cleaver to harvest a body on the spot. Yields no hide, skull or blood.
